ModMetaData.name: Faction Dynamics - Diplomacy and War
ModMetaData.author: Matt
ModMetaData.description:
A living world map. Faction settlements are founded, grow, and collapse over time; raids come from a real place on the map and are more likely from neighbours who live nearby; and raiders show up with a reason - hungry factions come for your food and leave once they have it, wronged factions come for revenge and fight to the end.
FEATURES - Dynamic settlements: NPC factions found, expand, abandon and lose settlements over time, with in-world reasons and vanilla-style letters for anything happening near you. - Raid regrouping: a settlement that just sent a raid at you is weakened while it regroups, and won't send another until it recovers. - Geography-aware raids: hostile neighbours close to your colony raid you far more often, with bigger groups and faster arrivals than factions on the far side of the planet. - Motivated raids: raiders can arrive starving (steal food, then leave), greedy (steal valuables, then leave), or vengeful (fight harder, retreat later). Each motivation changes targets, retreat conditions and letter text. - New quests: raid or defend other factions' settlements, and collect high-profile bounties on named pawns for the Empire and other powerful factions. - Everything is modular - each system can be turned off independently in mod settings.
MULTIPLAYER Built for RimWorld Multiplayer from the ground up: all world simulation is deterministic and tick-driven, all player actions route through synced commands, and mod settings are host-authoritative in a session.
Fully standalone. No hard dependencies. Requires Harmony.
